first_line: The paper's numbers partly hold up: 5 of 7 checked results match within their uncertainty. Its main result, US_supply_contrib_set_upper_2022Q2, is 7.3 percentage points in the paper and 5.351 percentage points here (not consistent). Sample size not rebuilt: BEA Underlying Detail Table 2.4.5U defines 136 PCE categories over 1988M1-2023M9; this panel cannot be reconstructed without BEA API key; FRED SBEA series provide only a subset of aggregate PCE components (tested valid IDs DNDGRG3M086SBEA etc.) and do not separately publish all 136 detailed categories; no other public source provides the full monthly panel (n_PCE_categories_total, 136 in the paper).

rejections.reason: the code that writes these results contains the number the paper reports for them (joint_hypothesis_upper_prob_robust (0.99) at line 344). Compute each result from the data; the paper's value never goes into it.
